item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena, a student in Jaipur, has a sore throat and mild fever. Her doctor checks her and says it is a viral cold, so no antibiotic is needed. Later, her uncle takes leftover antibiotic tablets whenever he feels slightly unwell. Which statement is correct?

options.A: Antibiotics are suitable for every infection, so Meena should take them for her cold.
options.B: Antibiotics kill bacteria, but careless use lets resistant bacteria develop, so the same antibiotic becomes less effective.
options.C: Careless antibiotic use makes bacteria easier to kill, so the same antibiotic becomes more effective.
options.D: A fever alone means an antibiotic is needed, so Meena must start antibiotics immediately.
